$description: CampusPulse design tokens: the one source for web and mobile. W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) format. Edit here (later: exported from Figma's variables), then run `bun run design:tokens` in web and in mobile. See docs/design-system.md.

raised.$description: Cards, sheets, anything above the page

sunken.$description: Wells and inputs, below the page

space.$description: Spacing scale. Used by mobile; the web uses Tailwind's default spacing for now.

radius.$description: Corner radii. Used by mobile; the web uses Tailwind's default radii for now.
